Warranty The s upplier shall provide comprehensive onsite warranty for the period specified in the GeM Bid/Technic al Specification. The warranty shall commence from the date of successful installation, commissioni ng and a acceptance of the equipment. During the warranty period, defects shall be rectified and de fective parts/com opponents replaced free of cost, as applicable. 28. Performance of Goods The supplied goods shall perform satisfactorily in accordance with the approved specifications and int ended purpose. Any defect affecting the performance of the equipment during the warranty period sha ll be rectified/replaced by the supplier without additional cost, as applicable. 29. Manuals and Documentation

The supplier shall provide printed and/or soft copies of Operation & Maintenance Manuals, Warranty Certificate, Technical Literature, Test Certificates, calibration certificates and other relevant docume nts, wherever applicable, at the time of installation/commissioning. 30. Shelf Life: For consumables, chemicals, reagents, or other shelf-life-sensitive goods, the supplied goods shall h ave the minimum residual shelf life specified in the Bid. Where no specific requirement is provided, the requirement shall be as specified by the applicable product standard/Bid condition. 31. Payment shal l be processed by the Centre, subject to statutory deductions, if any, and the applicable GeM payme nt mechanism. 32. Liquidated Damages If the supplier fails to deliver the service within the stipulated delivery period, Liquidated Damages s hall be applicable as per the GeM GTC and 33. Force Majeure Force Majeure shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable provisions of the GeM Contract. Neither party shall be liable for delay or failure in performance to the extent attributable to events r ecognized as Force Majeure under the applicable contractual provisions. 34. Compliance with Applicable Laws The supplier shall comply with all applicable Central Government, State Government and Local Auth ority laws, rules, regulations, notifications, GST provisions, labour laws and other statutory requirem ents during execution of the contract. Any liability arising due to non-compliance attributable to the supplier shall be borne by the supplier 35. Safety Requirements The supplier shall comply with applicable safety requirements during transportation, installation, tes ting, commissioning and maintenance. Any accident or damage attributable to negligence or omissi on of the supplier shall be the responsibility of the supplier. 36. Environmental Compliance Where applicable, the supplied goods shall comply with applicable environmental requirements. The supplier shall remove waste generated during installation/commissioning and dispose of the same in accordance with applicable regulations. 37. Assignment and Subcontracting The supplier shall not assign, transfer or subcontract the contract, wholly or partly, without prior writ ten approval of the Purchaser, except where expressly permitted under the GeM Contract 42. Right to Inspect OEM Facility Where specifically considered necessary and subject to the applicable GeM contractual provisions, the Purchaser may inspect the manufacturing facility, quality control process, warehouse or service centre

of the OEM/bidder for verification of the offered product/capabilities. 43. Governing Contract Documents and Order of Precedence The contract shall be governed by the GeM Contract, General Terms & Conditions (GTC), applicable Special Terms & Conditions (STC), Bid-specific Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC), Technical Specifi cations, Purchase Order and other applicable contract documents. In cas e of any conflict, ambiguity or in consistency among the contract documents, the matter shall be res olved in accordance with the applicable GeM contractual framework and the order of precedence pre scribed therein. Nothing contained in the Buyer Added ATC shall override the mandatory provisions of the GeM GTC/STC or applicable Government procurement rules. 50.
